thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: node provisioning failing in us-west-2 because image pulls from nv-artifacts.nvidia.com are returning 401/manifest errors. Auto-scaler failing to spin new nodes. Paging on-call for eng-infra and runtime.

alice (on-call): Acknowledged. I'm on it. Adding @raj and @maria. Any immediate customer-facing impact?

ops-sre: Early signal: autoscaler requests spiking with ImagePullBackOff during bootstrap, ~18% bootstrap failures in the last 10m across the gpu-provisioning pool. No existing pods restarted; only new node bootstraps affected.

raj (eng-infra): Seeing logs from k8s node bootstrap:
```
kubelet E0421 10:23:04.123456 1 docker_image.go:185] "Failed to pull image" image="nv-artifacts.nvidia.com/cuda:12.1" err="rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch manifest for nv-artifacts.nvidia.com/cuda:12.1: unauthorized: authentication required"
```
Also 401 from the registry auth endpoint: `401 Unauthorized - token missing`.

maria (runtime): This smells like the NV artifact proxy's token service flaking or Docker Hub/NV auth endpoint rate-limiting. We saw similar when auth proxy rotated certs earlier. Check if token-service returns 5xx or if upstream Docker Hub/OAuth provider is returning 503s.

alice (on-call): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Fail new bootstrap attempts to a safe fallback that has prebaked image (mirror or GCR). 2) Temporarily disable autoscaler for the affected pool to avoid cascading failures. 3) Start a DaemonSet prepuller on existing nodes so future pods will land while we fix registry auth. 4) Notify customers potentially affected.

raj (eng-infra): I'm flipping autoscaler drains: scaling down provisioner heuristics and pausing scale-ups for gpu-provisioning-pool. Doing now.

devops-bot: `kubectl patch clusterautoscaler cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'` -> SUCCESS

maria (runtime): Preparing prepuller DS. Pushing manifest now.
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: image-prepuller-temp
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prepull
        image: mirror.internal/nv-cuda:12.1
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 3600"]
      nodeSelector:
        node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu: ""
```
Applying to us-west-2 cluster.

ops-sre: Prepuller applied and running on 12 nodes. New pods scheduled on existing nodes succeed.

support-lead: Notifying customers in the affected orgs: delayed provisioning only. Drafting message: "We're seeing delays creating new GPU nodes in us-west-2 due to external registry auth failures; existing workloads unaffected. We're mitigating by using a mirrored image and will update when fixed." Sending now.

raj (eng-infra): Additional temporary fix: add imagePullSecrets to the node bootstrap cloud-init so nodes present a fallback credential while registry is flaky. Patch CLs to infra repo in flight: `infra/terraform: add nv-registry-secret to gpu node userdata`. Rolling that change to canaries.

alice (on-call): Can we also enable mirror fallback in the bootstrap script? If primary pull fails, try `mirror.internal/nv-cuda:12.1`.

maria (runtime): Yes. Pushing change to the bootstrap script and restarting the bootstrap process for the canary instance. If it works, we'll roll.

incidents-bot: Event update: upstream registry reported "Rate-limited token endpoint" at 10:27 UTC. Status page shows degraded auth service for nv-artifacts.nvidia.com.

raj (eng-infra): Canary bootstrap successful with added imagePullSecret + mirror fallback. New nodes now booting with prebaked mirror image. Rolling to remaining canaries.

ops-sre: After mitigation, bootstrap failure rate dropped from 18% -> 2% within 8 minutes. Autoscaler still paused.

alice (on-call): Customer impact update: 9 orgs reported delayed provisioning via support tickets. No job failures. ETA for full restore = until upstream registry auth rate-limits are cleared; we've mitigated for new requests with mirror/fallback but will need to keep autoscaler paused until we confirm stability.

support-lead: Ticket template posted to customers with affected orgs. Mentioned workaround and that we're tracking with upstream.

maria (runtime): Long-term mitigation items added to the incident board: 1) Bake GPU images into AMIs so bootstrap doesn't need remote pulls, 2) Implement more robust multi-registry fallback for bootstrap, 3) Add telemetry to detect registry auth latency early.

raj (eng-infra): Opening emergency PR to add baked images to the GPU node AMI pipeline. Also schedule a follow-up to tighten imagePullSecret rotation.

alice (on-call): Monitoring for upstream status. If auth endpoint fully recovers, we'll unpause autoscaler and roll back the mirror patch. For now keep autoscaler paused.

incidents-bot: Update: upstream registry reported partial recovery at 10:43 UTC. Auth errors decreased but still intermittent.

ops-sre: Unpausing autoscaler in staged fashion: enabling canary pool scale-up, watching bootstrap success for 10 minutes before global unpause.

devops-bot: `kubectl patch clusterautoscaler cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --field-selector=metadata.name=cluster-autoscaler` -> CANARY ENABLED

alice (on-call): After staged unpause, observed two more bootstrap failures but they recovered using mirror fallback. We'll keep monitoring for 30m.

support-lead: All nine affected orgs updated. No new customer complaints in last 20m.

maria (runtime): Marking incident as mitigated for production. Root cause: external registry auth/token endpoint rate-limited by upstream provider (NV artifact proxy chain), causing bootstrap image pulls to fail. Our mitigations prevented customer-facing outages.

raj (eng-infra): Follow-ups tracked: infra PR for baked AMIs (#492), bootstrap mirror fallback config (#493), autoscaler safe-guarding runbook update (#494).

alice (on-call): Closing the active paging loop. Final notes: impact limited to new node provisioning in us-west-2 for ~40 minutes, ~18% bootstrap failure at peak, no running pods affected. Thank you @raj @maria @ops-sre @support-lead. Filing post-incident doc.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT -> Mitigated. Closing thread.
